name: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited

facts.business: Gaudium IVF and Women Health Limited operates as a specialist, pure-play fertility-care platform providing assisted reproduction services through a network of 7 hubs and 28 spokes across more than 30 locations in India.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Litigation matters including arbitration proceedings initiated by Neomile Corporate Advisory Limited claiming ₹2,920.50 lakhs inclusive of GST; High Court appointed Sole Arbitrator on April 02, 2026; Company assessed claim as baseless and disclosed as contingent liability without provision.

key_risks: Regulatory compliance under ART (Regulation) Act, 2021 and Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2021
Litigation and contingent liabilities including arbitration claim of ₹2,920.50 lakhs
Market underpenetration with only ~2% of infertile population accessing treatment
Dependence on clinical outcomes and technology standardization across network
